scope: exploratory Basic target-hit task; inference adviser effectiveness
design: Three paired training seeds. No-goal joint DDQN uses environment reward; the matched goal policy uses balanced goals, goal rewards and exhaustive relabeling. Random, rule and LLM share the same frozen goal policy per training seed. This isolates adviser choice at execution, not teacher-guided learning.
primary_metric: target-hit rate including adviser errors as failures
decision_cost_definition: decisions to hit; 300 for every failed episode
